requirement: Messages keep accents and line breaks in compose URLs; an unlimited cap is still tracked

oracle.invariant: Compose doors only create a draft message, which decodes back verbatim. Chat accepts only known valid URLs; a cap of 0 does not block, and a batch over the cap is blocked. Instagram/Facebook profiles are turned into the ig.me/m or m.me chat doors; existing chat routes stay as they are, and feature pages never become recipients.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: compose links preserve punctuation, accents and line breaks in the draft; none sends it
known other chats open their existing URL; invalid hosts, credentials and scripts are refused
daily usage disables a batch before it would exceed the cap; zero stays uncapped
Instagram and Facebook profile contacts open direct chat routes instead of profiles
